notes: [S005.N1] This corrected typescript is manuscript page 4, with a separate pencil archive 4. It continues Picard classification and begins the underlined section 3, Catégories de Picard enveloppantes, corrected from an older 2. No date or page total is present. The page states a canonical homomorphism s from pi_0 to the two-torsion of pi_1, classification by pi_0, pi_1 and s up to noncanonical equivalence, and vanishing s as the strictness condition. These are source assertions, not classification results established here.

[S005.N2] A limited check of the torsion target was performed: the symmetry sigma_{X,X} is involutive, so its square is the identity. Under the source identification of Aut(X tensor X) with Aut(1)=pi_1, composition corresponds to addition, giving 2s(X)=0. This checks the two-torsion conclusion assuming that identification. It does not prove the homomorphism property, canonicity or the classification. The low-left 2 is preserved at all three occurrences. The extra high mark after the first arrow remains prime|point and is not assigned a mathematical role.

[S005.N3] Remarques describes strict Picard categories through a full subcategory of the derived category of (Ab), with homology outside 0 and 1 vanishing. The actual corrections move upper degrees/dots to lower positions: the earlier H superscripts are i|1, 1 and 0, and the live lower degrees are i, 0 and 1. These positions are visible independently of the expected mathematics. The source calls its preceding result assez grossier and qualifies the isomorphism by non unique !. Interlinear alors is typed and attaches after réduit from its position; H acknowledges the word but wrongly calls it handwritten.

[S005.N4] The prospective wording Il y aurait lieu, encore dans les limbes, and devraient être un jour … étudiés dans le cadre des champs is preserved. Deligne is a handwritten addition followed by empty reference brackets, which remain empty. The words interprété, qu’ils and Soient, the acronym order AUC, and the physical diaeresis in ëxemple are retained without grammatical repair. The two cancelled passages before nous venons and étudiés are transcribed where legible; the last two letters after étendus remain éu|áu|au.

[S005.N5] Section 3 poses the universal problem of an AUC tensor functor from C to a category in which F(X) is invertible for X in S. It states existence of a solution called a category de fractions and writes S^{-1}C. The page ends at le foncteur naturel; no continuation is supplied here. The inserted tensor prefix is actual typewritten ink with a pen hook, rather than editorially supplied text.

[S005.N6] All three complete readings were compared. The main reader inspected 23 reader B crops and four additional tight crops, 27 distinct crops. An earlier attempted five-image batch was truncated before images were delivered to the main model; the same stored crops were then displayed in smaller batches, without creating or revisiting a settled crop. The old e under 2, E under P, ordinary K, old section 2 and two dots of ëxemple are resolved; twelve loci remain uncertain. All substantive reader disagreements, including differing uncertainty orders, are recorded with all three choices. Pen layers are attributed to an unnamed hand; no personal hand identification was established.
